sample09.title: 新しい「日本語能力試験」問題例集 (New Japanese-Language Proficiency Test Sample Questions), published 2009
sample09.purposeQuoteJa: 2010年の試験改定の前に、改定内容を紹介するために発行された問題例集です。
sample09.purposeQuoteEn: a collection of sample questions published prior to the 2010 revision to introduce revision details
sample09.pageSays: Covers all item types for all levels, but 実際に出題される試験問題数とは異なります; footnote ※1: N1/N4/N5 test time and item counts in the structure PDF are outdated (see testsections page).

counts.method: Counted from the official 正解 (answer key) PDFs, which list item numbers per section.

sample09.audio: Yes, one MP3 per level; page footnote ※3 says audio covers 一部の問題のみ (some items only); full listening script PDF provided.
sample09.rightsNotes: Footnote ※2 restricts certain N1/N2 grammar/reading items (Asahi Shimbun credit, approval 22-1573); nothing specific for N4/N5. Workbook page states all listening audio contains third-party works; treat sample09 audio the same (link only) unless confirmed otherwise.
sample09.formatCaveat: Pre-2010 draft format; N5/N4 section times and item counts differ from the current test.

flagsForUser: No newly usable source of REAL JLPT questions. jlpt.jp still has only 公式問題集 2012 + 第二集 2018 (books list updated 2026-11-16, still no 第三集). The other official items (sample09, forlearners, forteachers) are the same 2009 sample items: N5 29, N4 34, pre-2010 format.

content/jlpt/source-registry.json uses https://samplequestions.jlpt.jp/... for all three sources; that host does not exist (NXDOMAIN). Should be https://www.jlpt.jp/e/samples/sampleindex.html and https://www.jlpt.jp/e/samples/sample09.html.

On jlpt.jp the 2012 workbook's 問題2 audio (N4, N5) now links samples/sample2017/mp3/N?Q2.mp3 (uploaded 2017-05-10, about 3x larger). Reng links samples/sample2012/mp3/N?Q2.mp3, which still works (2012 file). Check by listening whether the 2017 file is a replacement and whether Reng's link and script should follow it. No audio was downloaded.

New Vietnam warning: JF Hà Nội notice of 2026-06-25 (https://hn.jpf.go.jp/posts/thongbaoquantrongjlpt-vn) names 'thu thập, mua bán và phát tán trái phép đề thi cũ' as a violation that can cancel results and bar future tests. Cite it alongside the 2024-01-19 notice.

jpnotes.dev is the only third-party source with an open licence (footer: 'Content licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 — credit jpnotes.dev, non-commercial use only'). It is original AI-voiced listening practice, not real JLPT. Reuse would require credit, non-commercial use only, and a check of its '過去問の文法' pages. Not imported.

VNJPClub listed URL now redirects (nghe-hieu-n5-dap-loi-bai-02.html), and its robots.txt blocks Claude agents, so its content was not re-read. jlptsensei.com showed a bot challenge (HTTP 202) and was not bypassed.
Vietnam organisers (JF Hà Nội, CFL-USSH, VNU/Hanoi University via search) publish no sample tests; JEES info site has none either.
Catalog drift: jpnotes.dev now shows 146 (N5) / 150 (N4) recordings vs '80 per level' recorded on 2026-11-11.
